scope: Bounded fixture profile; external tools, not a complete or self-developed SV/UVM implementation

features.boundary: 8-bit wrap addition, arithmetic right shift by 3, signed/unsigned less-than and XOR; 64 fixed edge/random vector pairs
One packed nibble struct and two-bit enum; field access and $bits
Single package wildcard import and constant use
One automatic 8-bit rotate function, return value and argument passing
Default/named value parameter and an eight-lane generate-for hierarchy
Two nonblocking updates sampled after NBA on 32 positive edges; not all scheduling regions or races
Eight-element unpacked byte array, indexed writes/reads and literal readmemh stimulus
All 16 pairs of scalar 0/1/x/z: &, |, ^ and case equality; not complete four-state language semantics
One invalid-syntax fixture rejected independently; crashes/timeouts are not rejection success
Simple constructor, single inheritance and base-handle virtual dispatch; probe only
One interface/modport connected to a combinational module; probe only
Two four-bit class fields, eight samples constrained by a range and sum; explicitly contradictory call fails without changing fields
Inline allowed set and exact value intersect persistent class constraints; no comparison of random seeds, frequencies or distribution
Disabled field is fixed and still participates in constraints; one legal and one illegal fixed value, followed by re-enabling and solving
All three occupancies crossed with four input-valid/output-ready combinations and reset asserted/deasserted on one sampling edge; check both edge sides, drain, and two fresh words
Two-level parent/name hierarchy, direct child and relative lookup identity, absent-child query
Official-library build/run/report phase order for a single registered test; minimal probe
Official-library raise/drop in run phase with delayed observation; minimal probe, no drain-time closure
Object registration/create, one type override, derived cast/virtual behavior and direct-new isolation; no instance overrides
Typed integer config_db, two exact sibling scopes, child build get and missing-key non-update
Relative glob lane_*.sink matches two nested sink leaves and excludes a sibling tap; no regex or dynamic hierarchy
Build-time higher context wins over later lower context; equal-context latest wildcard wins over exact path; runtime latest write wins across contexts
Analysis port fanout to two subscriber exports, four transactions with both value/order and object identity; no asynchronous scoreboard
One sequence/sequencer/driver, four delayed get_next_item/item_done handshakes; ordered data/completion and watchdog; no arbitration/reset
Three contending sequences, strict priority and FIFO among equal priorities, six delayed item handshakes; no lock, grab or reset
Six reversed put_response deliveries after item_done, three sequence queues with overlapping transaction IDs, filtered get_response; no overflow or response handlers
A lock excludes three unrelated contenders across two items; unlock releases ownership and ordinary requests resume after both exclusive contenders
A later queued grab cannot preempt a holder, but gets ownership before one queued lock after release; explicit ungrab and ordinary request recovery; no multiple queued grabs or nested ownership
Explicit stop with one locked outstanding driver request and one queued contender; STOPPED states, no residual ownership or available request; driver drops the cancelled request
Restart the same stopped sequence object with an unread response and a reused transaction ID; restart clears its response queue and the fresh request completes with the fresh response
One clock, asynchronous active-low reset of a backpressured single-entry RTL response, driver cancellation at the next sample, lock release and one fresh transaction with a reused ID

Two-entry non-fall-through RTL FIFO, five constrained items observed through pin handshakes and UVM monitor publication, including pointer wrap, simultaneous transfers and drain; one unsatisfiable item withheld
Fixed 16-edge single-clock window: full FIFO stalls the driver, the sink stalls the output, and each valid word remains stable until handshaken

Reset a full two-entry FIFO with one additional stalled request and a ready sink; observe state before assertion, before and after the sampling edge, cancel the stalled UVM item and deliver two fresh words with reused IDs

Two full FIFO resets in a single run, each with a lock holder stalled on its third request and one blocked competing sequence; verify both cancellations, lock release, and fresh delivery with reused ID
One sequence and driver; three legal constraint solutions, each with the same ordered ID and fields at the sequencer pickup and analysis subscriber
One contradictory inline constraint in the middle of the sequence; failure preserves fields, dispatch is skipped, and the next legal item completes
Info/warning count deltas, zero errors; separate expected-fatal ID/count/termination probe with forbidden continuation; no full reporting policy coverage
